title: Website audit — sample
subtitle: SEO, AI-answer readiness and content risk
summary: Both sites sit in the at-risk band. The fastest lift is template work — bylines, author pages and linked sources — worth about 10 points on alpha-summit.com.
Blue Panda's score is provisional: robots rules blocked the fetch tool, and PageSpeed is still awaited.
method: Evidence gathered 6–8 October from homepages, listing pages and one article per site, confirmed by second-pass fetches.

sections.heading: Brand collision
paragraphs: A namesake agency in another country dominates the bare brand query. Brand plus city returns the client first.

fix_list.item: Add city and category to the homepage title and H1
